summary: First-party English and Norwegian discovery identified Stavanger kommune's kommunekart property-map route and Kartverket's national Matrikkelen services. The public Kartverket Eiendom API returned three safe Polygon features at the exact preserved WUP point, including one exact-point hit. Runtime remains held pending independent serial qualification.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries and HTTP routes, statuses, endpoint configuration inspection, schema/CRS findings, and scratch evidence paths are recorded in city-388-stavanger.json.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [58.9305804865162, 5.72277380778637] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and not shifted.
A 0 m exact-point hit is evidence of the returned parcel only, not citywide coverage.
The 100 m and 3000 m requests were bounded and capped at three features; they do not establish citywide completeness.
The Norgeskart cadastral WMS route returned HTTP 401 and was not bypassed.
No unsafe owner, address/contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or certificate fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.

Municipal viewer vector bootstrap was not separately qualified
doNotInfer: A WMS login wall is not evidence of parcel absence
A bounded API response is not citywide completeness
